I want to test a robust non‑parametric combination (median) on the full model pool because the series is seasonal dominated and ranking is unstable, so a simple median may perform well.
Seasonal dominance with unstable rankings suggests a robust trimmed mean may outperform weighted.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9062. Series context: trend strength 0.1199 and seasonal strength 0.6866; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.279); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.319.
